verdict.rationale: The justica.gov.pt Empresa Online guidance page was evidently readable: the pack quotes detailed text from it, including auth options, fees, steps and deadlines, which implies a public reading surface an agent could extract. However, no probe confirms an identified-UA fetch with no bot wall or JS shell, and the published eportugal.gov.pt entry path returns HTTP 404, so an agent following the official link hits a dead end. Missing for 10: a direct probe showing HTTP 200 with server-rendered content for an identified user agent on justica.gov.pt, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA, bot challenge or JS-only shell, and a working published entry URL instead of the 404.
